messages:
maria: alert: backup scan shows ~1.25k objects and ~380 snapshots created with SSE-S3 after this morning's RBAC changes. Anyone touch uploader roles?
devon: I applied role rename uploader-prod -> uploader-archive at 03:17 UTC as part of RBAC cleanup.
ashok: backup-agent expects a KMS grant scoped to the role's ARN. Role rename invalidated grant lookup, agent fell back to SSE-S3.
backup-bot: [automated] detected 1,252 PutObject with ServerSideEncryption: AES256 and 386 RDS snapshot uploads with KMS Encrypt AccessDenied. CSV exported to RED-ENC-463.
sam: sample log snippet:
`2026-03-21T03:20:09Z backup-agent ERROR KMS Encrypt Failed AccessDenied arn:aws:iam::123456:role/uploader-archive; falling back to SSE-S3`
maria: impact: customer restores should still work but objects not under CMK; compliance team flagged this.
devon: immediate steps: 1) create temporary KMS grant for new role ARN; 2) schedule controlled rewrite job to re-encrypt S3 objects; 3) snapshot re-upload or re-encrypt where possible; 4) add pre-deploy check for role-ARN-sensitive grants.
ashok: creating grant now and will paste grant-id. Reminder: grants are not retroactive, so rewrite needed.
devon: rewrite approach: lambda streaming copy for small batches -> verify crc32/md5 -> escalate to fleet job for remainder. Canary with 10 objects first. concurrency=40.
maria: I'll update runbook and open a compliance ticket with timeline. Also add alert for PutObject AES256 rate > 10/min.
sam: I'll validate DB snapshot restores from canary snapshots once re-encrypted.
backup-bot: remediation ticket RED-ENC-463 created and assigned to devon.
ashok: canary started (10 objects). posting results shortly.
maria: thanks everyone. Keep logs in this thread and tag security@ for audit.
